evidence_quotes: On page 1, delete lines 18 to 26 in their entirety and insert in lieu thereof the following: This bill would provide that the governing board of each educational institution or state educational institution shall oversee the construction and renovation of state property as it relates to each institution

This bill would require the Division of Construction Management to provide for the electronic submission and signing of documents. The bill would also require the division to make annual reports to the Legislature.

(2) Any powers, authority, and jurisdiction granted to the Division of Construction Management within this section relating to an educational institution or state educational institution is hereby transferred to the governing board of each institution
